limitations: All real-photo measurements are evidence/proxies, not physical identity truth.
J/S lack the new full stability protocol; do not compare apparent acceptance rates.
Dual-core inclusion can be a false merger warning, or two cues on one bead; zero is not proof of no leakage.
Overlap can mean duplicate proposals, false partition or uncertain identity; no calibrated real precision/recall.
